biggest_catch: Your friend must complete two $100+ direct deposits, two debit card transactions, and online banking registration within 60 days - otherwise you get nothing.
catches: Referrer: NASB customer who registers for the program and shares the offer; NASB employees ineligible; referrer must not have closed an account within the past 90 days with a negative balance.
Referrer earns a $50 Visa Reward Card per individual referred; 'A Referrer may receive up to ten (10) Visa Reward Cards ($500 value) within a calendar year.'

Friend must: register, open a new NASB personal checking account (Advance, Thrive, or Prosper; Money Market Checking does not qualify), and within 60 days: complete two (2) direct deposits of $100 or more, complete two (2) or more debit card transactions (excl. ATM), and register for Online Banking.
Only one referrer may receive a Visa Reward Card per referred person; only one Visa Reward per referred person regardless of accounts opened.
Referred offer only for new customers.
Visa Reward Card delivered 4-6 weeks after completion of all requirements; cards subject to terms delivered with the card; may be reported as income to the IRS.
NASB may change or discontinue the offer at any time.

payout_quote: The person making the referral (Referrer) will earn a $50 Visa Reward Card for each individual referred (Referred Person) to NASB who registers for the offer, opens a new NASB personal checking account (Advance, Thrive, or Prosper), and completes the requirements within the time specified in the offer. To make a referral, the Referrer must register for the program and share the offer with their friends, family, or coworkers. A Referrer may receive up to ten (10) Visa Reward Cards ($500 value) within a calendar year, but only one Referrer may receive a Visa Reward Card for each Referred Person who fulfills the requirements.
